headline: Drishyam The Conclusion Mania: Theatres Add Post-Midnight Shows Before Release, Exhibitors Told To Match Spider-Man Pricing
caption:

headline: Man sends AI crocodile picture to colleague, triggers search operation and now faces jail in Singapore
caption:
